description: This file defines server-side load function and actions for managing tags in a SvelteKit application, including loading tags, creating, updating, archiving, and restoring tags via API requests.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads tags data, checking admin permissions and fetching tags including archived status

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new tag with provided form data

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing tag identified by tagId with form data

methods.name: archive
methods.description: Archives (deletes) a tag identified by tagId

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a previously archived tag identified by tagId
